title: "Website"
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      noErrors: true
      printsMessage:
        level: WARN
        regex: 'dark-brand\.yml has no content and will be ignored'
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['nav.navbar']
        - ['.quarto-color-scheme-toggle', 'link.quarto-color-alternate']

The project dark brand file holds only comments and is ignored, so the navbar has no color-scheme toggle.
